text:
Predicates:
Capital(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
RankAmongBest(x) ::: x consistently ranks among the best universities in the world.
Premises:
Capital(beijing, peoplesRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
Capital(beijing, worldsMostPopulousNation) ::: Beijing is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(beijing, northernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Hosted(beijing, summerOlympics2008) ∧ Hosted(beijing, summerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
Hosted(beijing, summerOlympics) ∧ Hosted(beijing, winterOlympics) ∧ Hosted(beijing, summerParalympics) ∧ Hosted(beijing, winterParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics and the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
∃x (University(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, beijing) ∧ RankAmongBest(x)) ::: Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best universities in the world.
Conclusion:
¬(LargestChineseCity(beijing, second)) ::: Beijing is the second largest Chinese city.
